solution: $(2\\sin x-1)(\\sin x-1)=0$, so $\\sin x=\\tfrac12$ or $\\sin x=1$. For $\\sin x=\\tfrac12$: $x=\\tfrac{\\pi}{6},\\ \\tfrac{5\\pi}{6}$. For $\\sin x=1$: $x=\\tfrac{\\pi}{2}$. Solutions: $x=\\tfrac{\\pi}{6},\\ \\tfrac{\\pi}{2},\\ \\tfrac{5\\pi}{6}$.
